metadata.title: Lingo Agent
metadata.description: An open-source AI English tutor that remembers you.

home.tagline: Your AI English tutor. It remembers what you know and what you keep getting wrong.

login.title: Log in
login.description: Welcome back. Pick up where you left off.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Start practicing English with your AI tutor.

chat.confirmDelete: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.
chat.empty: Say anything in English - I'll reply and point out mistakes as we go.
chat.placeholder: Type a message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.stopped: Stopped. This partial reply is not saved.

connections.title: Model connections
connections.description: Add the model providers you want to use. Keys are encrypted on the server and never shown again.
connections.none: No connections yet. Add one below to start chatting.
connections.name: Name
connections.apiKeyHint: Leave empty only for local servers that need no key (e.g. Ollama).
connections.confirmDelete: Delete the connection "{name}"? Routes using it will skip it.
connections.modelPlaceholder: Pick from the list or type a model name
connections.modelsFound: The key works: {count} chat models available.
connections.modelsFoundNone: The key works, but no chat models were listed. Type a model name.
connections.modelsFailed: Couldn't fetch the model list: {error}. You can still type a model name.
connections.modelsNoMatch: No matching model. Your text will be used as-is.
connections.noDefaultModel: No default model yet: this connection isn't used for chat until you save one.
connections.newKeyPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current key
connections.renamePresetHint: The server's default routes find this provider by its name. After renaming, chat uses this connection's default model instead (your own routes are updated automatically).

route.title: Chat model
route.description: Models are tried in order; if one fails, the next one takes over.

source.default: Using the default order from the server configuration.
source.auto: Automatic: each connection's default model, in the order the connections were added.
source.none: No chat model is usable yet. Add a connection and save its default model.

route.editHint: Pick a connection and a model for each row. The first one is used; the rest take over if it fails.
route.modelsFailed: Couldn't fetch the model list. Type a model name.
route.modelsNoMatch: No matching model. Your text will be used as-is.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Token counts per day and model, as reported by the providers. Prices are not included.
usage.empty: No model calls in this period.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.tenant_missing: Your account is incomplete. Please contact the administrator.
errors.conversation_not_found: This conversation doesn't exist or was deleted.
errors.connection_not_found: This model connection doesn't exist or was deleted.
errors.route_not_found: There is no custom model setting for this task.
errors.connection_name_taken: A connection with this name already exists.
errors.no_llm_configured: No chat model is set up yet. Add a model connection in Settings.
errors.conversation_busy: A reply is still being generated. Please wait.
errors.llm_unavailable: The model is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
errors.validation_error: Some fields are invalid. Please check your input.
errors.network_error: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.http_500: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again later.
errors.stream_interrupted: The reply was cut off. Please try again.
errors.model_list_failed: Couldn't fetch the model list from the provider.
